'''Blorgworms''' were an [[Sentience/Legends|animal]] [[Species/Legends|species]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. In the [[S'kytri]] mythology, lumbering [[mutant]] blorgworms were one of the monstrous species that terrorized the surface of Skye until [[Hormaket]] the Vanquisher banished them to the catacombs of [[Entyrmion]]. In modern times the S'kytri used slow-burning blorgworm oil as fuel for torches.
